description: This file defines Drupal behaviors related to filtering module list tables by text input, including handling of package details and search filtering logic.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Initializes the behavior to filter module list table based on user input, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: hidePackageDetails
methods.description: Hides or shows package details based on the visibility of contained rows.

methods.name: filterModuleList
methods.description: Filters module list rows based on search query, toggling visibility and managing package details display.

methods.name: preventEnterKey
methods.description: Prevents form submission or default action when Enter key is pressed in the input field.
